title: Check leaks by words only the key carries
statement: Check hints and wrong-answer replies for leaks in code: none may carry a word only the key or its criterion's answers carry, not counting the criterion's framing words.
example: A leak check that counted the criterion's framing words 'reason' and 'any' withheld a hint and left a child on a third miss with only the question restated.
detail: A reading course checks leaks in code: an item-statistics review collects each criterion's answer words of more than 4 characters and looks for them in that criterion's hints (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/lens-item-stats.md`), and its feedback validator holds any wrong-answer reply that names or paraphrases the key, quotes six words of the correct option, or names a word only the key carries (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/BUILD-SPEC-batch.md`). A merge then changed what a child got on a third miss: the old check had flagged 'reason' and 'any', words from the criterion's own framing, not from any answer, and withheld the second hint, leaving only the question restated; the version that stopped counting such words gave the hint (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-2026-09-16/pr263-merge/RED-REGISTER.md`).
against: A leak gate run on a generated reply, rather than an authored one, had the reply rewritten, and the rewrite misread the story (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/lens-judge-probe.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/round-5/peter-pan-evidence-repairs-2026-09-10/glossary/HINT-AND-MORPHOLOGY-TRIAGE.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/feedback-reconciliation/invariants.dom.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/engine/reports/PETER-PAN-IMPROVEMENTS-2026-09-28.md`).
